description: Defines builder classes for constructing RACH.indication PDUs and messages, including setting parameters like time domain, frequency domain, power, and adding preambles, as specified in SCF-222 v4.0 section 3.4.11.

classes.name: rach_indication_pdu_builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing and setting parameters of RACH.indication PDU.

classes.name: rach_indication_builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing and setting parameters of RACH.indication message.

methods.name: set_time_domain_parameters
methods.description: Sets symbol and slot indices for the PDU.

methods.name: set_frequency_domain_parameters
methods.description: Sets the RA index for the PDU.

methods.name: set_power_parameters
methods.description: Sets average RSSI and SNR for the PDU.

methods.name: add_preamble
methods.description: Adds a preamble with specified parameters to the PDU.

methods.name: set_slot_point
methods.description: Sets the slot point of the RACH.indication message.

methods.name: add_pdu
methods.description: Adds a PDU to the RACH.indication message with specified parameters.
